sections.title: Right now
lines: Pre-race growth, green flag Sun 1:00pm CT. Sold 380, 27,925 resting. Worst line -$140.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A driver gets a new wave when 90% of what he offered has sold.
Growth phase: waves allowed down to -$2,000 per driver, limited by free cash.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It stops a driver whose line falls under -$550.
Glide starts Sun 9:00am CT: limit slides from -$550 to +$150 by Sun 1:00pm CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from Sun 11:30am CT.
Even-up from Sun 1:00pm CT, last-resort take from Sun 12:40pm CT, green flag Sun 1:00pm CT.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: waves, price steps and the glide run by rule. The worst line may not fully close.
